tldr: Sequential gold-audit feedback and report-conditioned batch auditing have the same evaluated compact-uniform minimax correction \(2\lambda(1-\rho)/\rho-C_A\). Their original-game value difference is uniformly \(o(n^{-4/3})\). The curve \(\lambda_*(\rho)=C_A\rho/[2(1-\rho)]\) separates risk below and above \(1/n\) by any fixed coefficient margin; on the curve both values equal \(1/n+o(n^{-4/3})\), uniformly in \(\rho\). Independent fair treatment, uniform hard-budget batch audits and an observable residual-corrected Airy shrinker attain both expansions. The separate certified finite game has a strict feedback gain at \((n,m,K)=(4,2,2)\). The positive-error paired truth/report class differs from the published clean anchor class; \(K=0\) recovers that class exactly, and the truth projection remains the full anchor binary class. The sharp converse transfers upward from a legal sparse subclass to the full capped class. These results are conditional on a public, externally pre-certified both-potential discrepancy cap; factual gold audits do not identify or validate it.
gap: Gold residual correction and clean unrestricted minimax shrinkage are separately available. Their combination has no verified sharp fixed-cap benchmark once adjudication indices can respond to previously observed gold outcomes.
